summary: JBS N.V. disclosed that its wholly-owned Brazilian subsidiary JBS S.A. signed a Brazilian-law association agreement with Viva Holding Ltda. on September 15, 2026, to combine their leather production, processing and commercialization assets into a new 50/50 joint venture named JBS Viva. JBS S.A. contributes JBS Couros quotas (its leather division); Viva Holding contributes Viva shares. Governance is parity: up to six directors, three each, with JBS naming Chairman (no casting vote) and CFO, Viva naming CEO and COO. Excluded: collagen/gelatin assets and the Cactus, Texas leather plant. Closing is conditions-based; no price, premium, or advisor disclosed. Watch antitrust and corporate-reorganization execution risk.
